selected_route.title: The Bite Was Already Hers
selected_route.one_line_machine: He tore the bite for himself; she took it like it was already theirs; he looked at her face and let the moment become love.

concept_process_card.name: Banter To Belonging
concept_process_card.reason: The scene starts as a tiny funny boundary-crossing food beat, then turns into belonging through Zuv's amused, active softness.

layer_e.emotional_obstacle: A tiny personal boundary is crossed at the family table: the bite he prepared for himself disappears before he eats it.
layer_e.reader_mirror: Couples who have invisible rights over each other's food, blanket, pillow, charger, or personal space.
layer_e.aachu_proof: Aachu keeps taking the roti bite as soon as he tears it open.
layer_e.zuv_role: Zuv notices and looks at her face instead of guarding the food; his gaze turns the joke into acceptance.
layer_e.earned_ending: Some love is when even your first bite starts becoming ours.

story_selling_score.repair_note: Sharpen public hook at copy-lock so it does not read like the rejected food-denial lane.

golden_theme_score.repair_note: Do not over-romanticize the thesis; keep the deadpan domestic receipt.

story_director_lock.hook: Invisible bite rights inside a family meal.
story_director_lock.setup: Zuv is eating and talking with father.
story_director_lock.proof: Every time he opens a roti bite, Aachu takes it.
story_director_lock.escalation: It happens repeatedly while the conversation continues.
story_director_lock.bridge: His attention moves from the missing bite to her face.
story_director_lock.active_zuv_role: He chooses softness through the look and the unguarded hand.
story_director_lock.ending: Love has made a tiny part of his plate theirs.
story_director_lock.send_save_reason: It names the funny private permissions couples recognize instantly.

selected_route.selector_rationale: This winner preserves the creator's literal lived moment and uses the father conversation as specificity without making it private-only. It clears the memory warning by avoiding 'not hungry' and 'extra bite' logic. Its strongest asset is the visual reversal: the missing bite matters less than the way Zuv looks at Aachu.

copy_status.rejection_reason: Creator rejected this as too preachy for the raw daily-life scene.
copy_status.recommended_proof_on_image_text: bas papa se baat kar raha tha
copy_status.note: Textless proofs are blocked, but the proof line must be scene-native and creator-approved before regeneration.

rejected_proof.reason: STOP. Dimension gate failed at 978x1608. Story gate failed because Zuv looks at Aachu instead of father. Hand/object gate failed because Zuv still has a bite in his hand. Copy gate failed because the line is too preachy.

image_status.blocker: Next proof must first pass storyboard approval, then be generated natively at exact 1080x1080 with exact approved on-image text. Textless proofs, wrong-dimension proofs, wrong eye-line, wrong hand state, and preachy proof text are blocked.
image_status.recommended_father_handling: Use father as off-frame voice, side/back silhouette, or table-edge presence unless identity references are supplied.
